Notes.Text:
This update for ruby3.4 fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-132825: Heap buffer overflow in case conversion of strings (bsc#1290919).
- Double free in regular expression compilation (bsc#1290920).
- Heap buffer overflow in Regexp#to_s (bsc#1290925).
- Heap buffer overflow in regular expression compilation (bsc#1290924).
- Integer overflow in case conversion of strings (bsc#1290921).
- Out-of-bounds read in case-insensitive backreference matching (bsc#1290926).
- Out-of-bounds read in case-insensitive regular expression matching (bsc#1290923).

Changes for ruby3.4:

Update to 3.4.13

 - Bug #22477: rb_ec_clear_vm_stack() can still clear the VM stack before
 ec->cfp = NULL on aarch64
 - Bug #22479: File.realdirpath returns a wrong path when GC runs while it
 resolves a relative symlink
 - Bug #22476: rb_profile_frames() called from a signal handler segfaults
 while vm_make_env_each() is escaping a chain of frames
 - Bug #22416: Respect timezone abbreviation encodings in Time#strftime
 - Bug #22436: Array#zip with a method_missing-based argument leaks a stale
 block handler (segfault when the next C-called method yields)
 - Bug #22449: Out-of-bounds in Array#sample when array modified
 - Bug #22450: Jump value attaches block in incorrect place under parse.y
 - Bug #22456: IO#close hangs forever when another thread is writing to the IO
 from a trap handler (please backport ba68343d3a to 3.4)
 - JIT: Reject --{y,z}jit-exec-mem-size values that overflow the u32
 reservation size by st0012 . Pull Request #19720
 - Bug #22451: Coderange may be set incorrectly when concatenating a string into itself
 - Bug #20655: Calling continuation triggers ensure function of rb_ensure
 - Bug #22458: Time#strftime out-of-bound access
 - Bug #22461: Use-after-free in String formatting with wide character encodings
 - Bug #22471: Thread#name= on a terminated thread may dump core
 - Bug #22467: IO#readpartial can raise EFAULT during GC.compact in another thread
 - Bug #22480: Ruby's release tarballs are not POSIX compliant since 2018
 - Bug #22491: The number of captures may change depending on the encoding
 of the target string
 - Bug #22389: Hang on GC.compact
 - Feature #22238: String#tr to take a Hash for multi-character replacements
 - Bug #22382: IO#write of a shareable String from multiple Ractors causes
 use-after-free
 - Bug #22535: Release mode segfault due to half-initialized error in singleton_method
 - Bug #22504: Empty keyword hash mishandled when calling a Method proc through the C API
 - Bug #22512: Overflow in st_init_existing_table_with_size / Hash.new(capacity:)
 - Bug #22495: UTF-32 strings with a byte 0x80 or more in the most significant
 position are reported as valid
 - Bug #22518: String#unpack("m") computes the buffer size with an overflowing multiplication
 - Bug #22517: Some String methods return a UTF-16/32 string without room for its terminator
 - Bug #21142: Lazy enumerator .each_with_index ignores .take(0) before it
 - Bug #22496: Lazy enumerator .each_with_index no longer executes block
 - Bug #22540: Process.spawn leaves the env, umask, and redirections applied
 in the parent on Windows when chdir: fails
 - Bug #22492: String#rindex misses a match with a leading .* in multiline mode
 - Bug #22494: Regexp search misses a match when an assertion precedes a leading .*
 - Bug #22537: IO#gets(nil, limit) stops right after a 0xFF byte
 - Fix memoization for the /(...){0}/ case by makenowjust . Pull Request #13169
 - Bug #21304: heap-use-after-free of Array#hash via mutating hash method
 - Ensure safe handling of hexdump width. by ioquatix . Pull Request #16593
 - Bug #21974: Cannot inspect RubyVM::AST for CDECL
 - Bug #22333: Assertion Failed: ary_resize_capa:RARRAY_LEN(ary) <= capacity
 - Bug #22410: IO#external_encoding / IO#internal_encoding segfault on an uninitialized IO
 - Bug #22409: ASan UAF and Assertion Failed: gc_validate_pc:CFP_PC(cfp) >= iseq_encoded:
 PC not set when allocating, breaking tracing
 - Bug #22543: Segmentation fault when compiling CONST ||= value, CONST &&= value
 or CONST += value under # shareable_constant_value: literal (Prism compiler)
 - Skip whitespace in rb_memory_view_parse_item_format fill pass by fuzzyrichie . Pull Request #19807
 - Bug #22557: parse.y segmentation fault parsing malformed nested case
 - Check the result of compile_length_tree() at every call site by mame . Pull Request #19505
 - Bug #22597: Regexp named capture names with invalid source encoding
 - Bug #22599: parse.y rejects valid retry after a class / class << self
 definition inside rescue (Invalid retry after ensure)
 - Bug #22433: IO#sysread and IO#pread are inconsistent for length 0 and negative numbers
- from version 3.4.12
 - Bug #22342: IO#gets can ignore the limit argument in some edge cases
 - Bug #22284: Passing an object with to_int to curry as its arity causes problems with LLP64.
 - Bug #22387: str_shared_replace incorrectly recalculates termlen
 - Bug #22391: Fix propagation of errno in rb_io_maybe_wait.
 - Bug #22388: Use-after-free when an Enumerable retains its each block
 - Bug #22326: heap buffer overflow in array.values_at()
 - Bug #22423: String#initialize(encoding:) stores an inflated capacity and
 writes past the malloc'd buffer on append (rb_str_init termlen double-adjust)
 - Prevent double free for too big repetition quantifiers by makenowjust . Pull Request #13332
 - Bug #22415: Thread.handle_interrupt needs to preserve errinfo
 - Bug #22406: Process.fork can leave the child unable to resolve hostnames: getaddrinfo
 helper threads take glibc's resolver lock after releasing the fork lock
 - Bug #22445: On macOS, a child of Kernel#fork can abort with
 "[BUG] pthread_rwlock_destroy: Resource busy (EBUSY)"
 - Reject overflowed repeat/null-check IDs in huge regexps by makenowjust . Pull Request #16801
 - Bug #22384: Regexp compile error in the 2nd+ branch of a top-level
 alternation leaks the parse tree (regression from #13332, Ruby 4.0)
- from version 3.4.11
 - Bug #22196: Heap-use-after-free in fiber_switch with transfer-terminated async tasks on 3.4.10
 - Guard fiber target across fiber_store. by samuel-williams-shopify . Pull Request #17951
 - Bug #21842: Encoding of rb_interned_str
 - Bug #22126: Stack underflow for partial DCE and loops
 - Bug #22124: void value missed in parse.y
 - Bug #22183: parse.y interpolation inside lambda literal
 - Bug #22099: Keyword-only method silently accepts a positional argument
 - Bug #22133: Ruby's default SIGINT handling ignores Thread.handle_interrupt masking.
 - Bug #22189: Enumerator::Lazy#to_enum does not accept method names as strings
 - Bug #22191: Signal.trap(:EXIT) exception only shown if at_exit also raises
 - Bug #22198: win32: heap overflow in Kernel#system
 - Bug #20958: fix ENV.keys encoding on windows
 - Bug #11438: native_thread_init_stack() get machine.stack_start unequal to thread's
 stack start address, x86 win32
 - Bug #22218: Line TracePoint misses executed loop condition after a guard
 - Bug #22223: Socket.tcp with connect_timeout returns a phantom "connected" socket
 for a refused connection on macOS 27 (kernel answers EISCONN on connect retry;
 SO_ERROR never consulted)
 - Bug #22290: Adding instance variables to anonymous object may bloat all future classes
 - Bug #22269: Coverage.line_stub clobbers already-collected coverage data
 - Bug #22257: Prepending a module to an already-included module leaves stale super caches
 - Handle spurious wakeups in Thread#join. by samuel-williams-shopify . Pull Request #13532
 - Bug #22311: Build crashes on macOS 26 with the macOS 27 SDK because pipe2() and dup3()
 are unavailable
 - Bug #22259: Arrays sharding a buffer segfault when concatenating with each other
 - Bug #22264: Warning missing from parse.y hash literals
 - Bug #22303: EncodingError from interpolating symbol crashes whole process
 - Bug #22315: heap-use-after-free in String unpack with a block that mutates the receiver
 - Bug #22318: heap uaf triggered in array.flatten
 - Bug #22319: heap buffer overflow triggered by array's zip function
 - Bug #22322: AddressSanitizer: use-after-poison in econv_description
 /ruby-src/build/../transcode.c
 - Bug #22321: Assertion Failed: rb_vm_search_method_slowpath:RB_TYPE_2_P(klass,
 RUBY_T_CLASS, RUBY_T_ICLASS): klass: T_MODULE
 - Bug #22334: Assertion Failed: VM_ENV_FLAGS:FIXNUM_P(flags)
 - Bug #22336: IO:Buffer Heap uaf
 - Bug #9932: Permutation - Segment fault
 - Bug #22330: heap uaf from string.encode()
 - Bug #22340: Win32: File.stat succeeds on symbolic-link loops on Windows
 - Bug #22335: Stack corruption with >31 keyword args and refined Integer#==
 - Bug #22338: [Backport] win32: create directory symlinks for relative directory targets

Vulnerabilities.Description: Ruby before 3.3.14, 3.4.13, and 4.0.10 has a heap-based buffer overflow during case conversion. One byte can be written outside a buffer for, for example, ISO-8859-1 or Windows-1252.
